name: Jackson L. Burnside III and Stanley Burnside

name: Ras Ishi Butcher

note: Curator, writer and visual artist; co-founded ARC Magazine; Chief Curator National Art Gallery of The Bahamas to end 2019; recent bios say between Scotland and the Caribbean (Barbados). No Instagram handle in results.

name: Charles Campbell
gallery: The Goldfarb Gallery (solo 'An Ocean to Livity', Feb-Apr 2025); Waap Art
note: Jamaican-born; 2022 VIVA Award; 2025 Sobey Art Award Pacific finalist. No own website/Instagram found.
